prompt: Single game hero sprite: A compact chibi lion beastman brawler about 2 heads tall, built for animation, the head with its mane about as big as the whole body below it: a big spiky dark red-brown mane around the head, a round barrel chest, TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH, TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH, short thick limbs, golden-tan fur with a cream muzzle and a cream chest patch, a short snout with a dark nose, a fierce brow line and two small eye slits, two small round ears in the mane; he wears only a saturated blue waist sash with one short hanging cloth end and short blue trousers, big bare paw feet; on EACH fist an identical bright-gold gauntlet with three short curved claws; a long thin tail with a dark tuft curving up behind him; no other weapon; golden-tan main colour, saturated blue cloth, bright gold claws. NEAR-FRONT VIEW from a high top-down camera: the body faces the viewer and is turned only about 20 degrees toward the RIGHT, the face looking right, the whole chest visible. The left and right halves of the body are almost mirror images. BOTH ARMS are fully visible and drawn at the SAME size, one on each side of the torso, neither arm hidden behind the body; BOTH LEGS are fully visible, the same size and length, neither hidden. Not a flat profile, not a straight front view. Standing UPRIGHT in a calm neutral idle stance: the body vertical, not leaning, both feet planted shoulder-width apart side by side on ONE horizontal ground line, both arms hanging down at his sides in a slight A-pose, held clearly AWAY from the body with a wide gap between each arm and the torso, the arms never crossing in front of the chest or the belly, the clawed fists at hip height, claws pointing down; the tail behind him on the left, clear of the legs and arms. Full body, centered, filling about 70% of the frame. The face is only a brow line and a small eye slit; hands are simple fists inside the gauntlets, visible. No buckles, no pouches, no straps beyond one, no rope, no bandages, no spikes, no stitches, no patches, no fabric texture, no fur texture: fur and clothing are a few big flat shapes. At most three colour families. The claws, the mane, the tail and every part of the body stay inside the frame with margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette; small details are left out or merged into larger shapes; faces, hands, armour and clothing are suggested with a few lines, never rendered in fine detail. Stylized, exaggerated cartoon proportions, not realistic anatomy (about 2.5 to 4 heads tall): the parts that express the character's role are enlarged and the rest is shrunk, so the silhouette reads at 60 pixels. Colour: flat solid fills only, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Volume and shadow come from 2-3 hard-edged tones of the same colour (shadow, base, light), plus a few small highlight shapes. Thick clean outlines in a dark shade of the neighbouring colour. Effects (fire, ice, magic, poison, glow, energy) are drawn as stacked layers of flat single-colour vector shapes with an outline that follows the effect's form (flame tongues, ice shards, drips, sparks), never as soft blur or gradient glow. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
